title: Fixed U Return Rod Ball and Open Tine Box Rattle
description: One newly authored complete fixed U-return-rod rattle-style percussion appearance. A single continuous round-section metal rod makes a broad rear return between a whole round wooden ball and a thick rectangular wooden resonator box. The box is one closed wall mesh with a genuine full front opening and deep blind interior, not a black mouth decal. Six complete finite short metal tines are rooted into its inside roof and stop above its floor, visible through the opening. All parts are newly authored whole geometry, not a castanet shell reshaped or a cabasa handle retained with bead loops removed. The complete ball-to-return-rod-to-open-tine-chamber relation distinguishes it from the old paired cord-linked pear shells and the straight-grip externally beaded cylinder. One whole prop zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR appearances, metres native Z up and complete horizontal-envelope-centred ground origin on the box bottom. Static stylized instrument appearance only; no elastic response, rattling, sound, tuned pitch, hand fit, impact resistance, playability, manufacture or safety claim. No rig, animation or interaction.
